science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
text: [DAWN_SHIFT at The_First_Forge] Hector caught the heavy calibration baton, immediately bounding up the copper gantry while the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea whipped against the outer hull. He laughed as an arc of stray voltage tickled his palm, breathing in the sweet ozone as if it were mountain air. Hooking his boots into a precarious structural brace to free both hands, he rapidly spliced the new metrics into the induction shunt, feeling the chaotic hum stabilize beneath him before tossing the baton down directly to Kaio.

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Calibrate the upper induction shunts before the shear wave overloads the forge
horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Reinforce the First Forge against the rising ferrofluid sea
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Maintain structural stability during the impending suns' polarity inversion

active_location.macro_silhouette: The First Forge stood as a fortress of brass and copper, its soot-stained walls humming with trapped kinetic energy and heat. High copper gantries crisscrossed the ceiling, vibrating with raw electrical potential.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Blue arcs of stray voltage and soot-stained brass walls
sensory_palette.sound: Chaotic hum of induction shunts stabilizing
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: Electrifying tingle mixed with radiant forge heat

interactive_features.affordance_description: A precarious elevated walkway requiring balance and speed.
Ambient energy that can be harnessed to power tools if caught correctly.
The primary pressure relief valve for the forge's electrical load.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: Weaken the primary brass struts supporting the forge's viewport
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Exploiting the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear to create resonant frequencies
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: The structural diagnostics are picking up a dangerous resonance spike
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: Will cause a micro-fracture in the viewport, letting in toxic magnetic vapor

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: Hector must rapidly splice the metrics into the induction shunt.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: Kaio needs the stabilized grid to run the next set of diagnostics.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: The First Forge must survive the chaotic magnetic forces to build future colony defenses.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: Hector will slip on the gantry, delaying the splice and causing a minor arc flash.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: You slip and take a direct arc hit, singeing your tunic and scrambling the baton.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Kaio catches the baton as the grid hums perfectly. What does Kaio do?
